videoTitle: The One Thing 'Unscented' Lotion Labels Don't Tell You About Migraines
videoDescription: If fragrance triggers your migraines but your skin is desperately dry, you're not stuck. The label you need isn't 'unscented'—and the texture that actually works might surprise you. Find out what dermatologists recommend at mindtivate.com
script: You've been told to buy unscented lotion for migraines. But unscented can still contain fragrance—it's the masking kind. What you actually need is fragrance-free, and for truly dry skin, it's not even a lotion at all...
Visit mindtivate.com to find out what works.
thumbnailConcept: A close-up, dimly lit shot of a woman sitting on the edge of her bed, wincing in pain with her eyes shut tight as she presses one hand firmly against her temple to cope with a sudden migraine, while her other hand holds a white lotion bottle with the word "UNSCENTED" clearly visible on the label.
